title: Mr. Mime Can Make Belief Real
premise: Mr. Mime's pantomime can make an unseen object real once watchers believe in it.
audiencePromise: Follow Mr. Mime's gestures as they convince watchers, then see its fingertips solidify air into invisible walls.
openLoop: Does Mr. Mime create the object, or does belief create it first?
payoff: Belief makes the unseen object exist, while Mr. Mime's fingertips can harden air into an invisible wall.
engagementQuestion: Is belief the real power, or Mr. Mime's fingers?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and clearly. Build quiet suspense through the clues, then punch the reveal. Stress belief, real, and invisible wall. End curious and inviting.
